_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Keddaɣ ad tekkiɣ {player_id} ɣef waddad n {num_players} n uddaden n warraz n azar.
Tawuriwin:
- Mi tekkiɣ dawed, zemreɣ ad tekkeɣ:
  1) Aɣriɣ ayyawen s uɛdaw n uqariɣ uɛdaw neɣ uɛdaw n tafat (neɣ kunu) i uɛdaw n tawuri tura; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Aɣriɣ ayyawen n uɛdaw aneggaru s tikti n '[Call]'.

Mi tekkiɣ aɣriɣ ayyawen:
  - Mi tawuri n tafat n uɛdaw n tafat ɣef akk tuɣalin ɛeddaw n uɛdaw, uɛdaw aneggaru yettara azar.
  - Wella, uɣriɣ ayyawen yettara azar.
Uddad yettawi 0 tuɣalin yettara. Uddad aneggaru yettawi.

board.new_round:
Asaru amaynu - Ifsan iddan : {dice_summary}
Ifsan inu tetty ddan : {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Uddad {current_player_id} itekka! Tawuri n tafat n {face_value} ɛeddaw {count}, i ɛeddaw d aɣellaw n {quantity}.
Uddad {loser_id} (uɛdaw aneggaru) yettara azar.
call.caller_loses:
Uddad {current_player_id} itekka! Tawuri n tafat n {face_value} ɛeddaw {count}, i ɛeddaw d aɣellaw nɣ aɛdaw n {quantity}.
Uddad {loser_id} (uɣriɣ ayyawen) yettara azar.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: ⴰⵙⵉⵓⴰⴷ ⵉⵋⵋⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵓⴰⵔ ⵜ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴰⵍⵎⵓⴷ ⵏ ⴰⵣⵣⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⴷⴰⵜⴰ.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Aseɣwen ur tetty ittuskar s wa d aseɣwen amaynu '[Bid: X, Y]' neɣ '[Call]'. Aseɣwen ittin : {action}
